text:
No hiring choice can be put forward from this run, because the £400k/year salary constraint was not assessed.

- Annual salary spend has no stated amount for any option, so the analysis treated it as unchanged; it cannot establish budget compliance. The `< £400k/year` limit also lacks a usable comparison frame.
- The result is very low-robustness and near-tied, based entirely on Olumi’s provisional estimates rather than user-validated inputs.
- Delivery capacity and onboarding load materially shape the comparison, but their estimates are likewise unvalidated; the goal’s direction was also assumed rather than stated.

The key missing reasoning is the annual salary spend for each staffing scenario.
